description:
## For scheduling a pick up from:

- **Tall Ship** (Portside, Lewis Mall, The Smoke Shop, Clippership)
- **Reel House** (East Boston)

Select the date and time that work for you. On the following page, you will select the location you would like to be picked up at and where you would like to be dropped off. Please see "Additional details" or our [location stop map](https://www.bostonwatertaxi.com/stop-map) for exact instructions on locating your desired pickup location.

**PLEASE NOTE THAT YOU ARE NOT BOOKING THE EXACT TIME, BUT RATHER A 15-MINUTE TIME WINDOW. PLEASE BE READY AT THE DOCK AT THE BEGINNING OF THE WINDOW AS WE MAY BE SERVICING OTHER PASSENGERS AND ARE UNABLE TO WAIT.**

If you are booking transportation to Logan Airport, please budget 30-40 minutes total travel time from Dock to Terminal. This transit time includes both the water taxi trip and the airport shuttle bus from the Airport dock to the terminal.
what_is_included:
We offer a variety of tickets to suit every passenger's needs:

# **One Way Ticket**

- Water Taxi to one of our stops in the harbor

# **Round Trip with Luggage Storage Ticket**

- Water Taxi from one of our East Boston stops to Rowes Wharf
- Same-day luggage storage at Rowes Wharf (no limit on the number of bags)
- Water Taxi to Logan Airport later in the day

# **Harbor Experience Ticket**

- 30-minute ride on the Water Taxi
- Drinks available for purchase on board
- May be servicing other passengers during the activity

faqs:
## How does the taxi to Logan work?

It's as easy as it gets! Just book your pickup time and location and select Logan as your destination. You'll be picked up by your Water Taxi in the selected time window and, after a 10-20 minute ride, dropped off at the Water Transportation Dock at Logan Airport. From there, you just walk up the ramp and catch a free shuttle bus to your terminal (White and blue #66 bus, picks up directly above the dock every 15 minutes and drops off at every terminal).

Please budget 45 minutes of total travel time from pickup to terminal, including the Water Taxi ride and the shuttle bus.

## Does the Water Taxi go through all the stops?

No, the Water Taxi's route is determined by the scheduled pickups at the time. Most rides are direct point-to-point rides, but the Water Taxi might make a couple stops on the way to drop off or pickup additional customers. During peak demand times (mostly weekends during the summer season), there might be additional stops.

## What happens if I miss my scheduled time?

If you think you won't make your scheduled pickup time, please contact us directly at [617-406-8584](tel:6174068584) and we will try to arrange a pickup for the next available time. Please keep in mind that this is subject to demand at the time and other scheduled pickups. 

If it is past the time of your reservation, you cannot cancel. You will forfeit the amount paid if you do not contact us prior to the pick up time.

## Where exactly is your pickup?

For detailed instructions on getting to our pickup locations, please refer to our [location stop map](https://www.bostonwatertaxi.com/stop-map) or check out the "Additional information" tab.

## How do I book the one way with luggage storage?

Please select the time when you will be dropping off your luggage and the number of passengers. You will then meet one of our team members at our [Rowes Wharf](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7EutjFpp8PypSn8y8) location where we will help store your luggage and arrange a time for your transportation to Logan Airport.

## Are the taxis wheelchair accessible?

Unfortunately, no. All of our taxis require a couple steps to board the boat. If you have any specific mobility concerns, please contact us directly at [info@bostonwatertaxi.com](mailto:info@bostonwatertaxi.com) or [617-406-8584](tel:617-406-8584)

## Can I bring a pet / stroller / bike on board?

- We are more than happy to transport your furry friends at no additional cost. Our taxis are often a shared riding experience, so we do ask that your pet be leashed while aboard. 
- Bikes are also allowed aboard at the discretion of the Captain, and available space. Typically we have room aboard, but may not be able to accommodate during times of peak demand.
- Strollers can be loaded aboard our vessels. For the safety of all passengers, these must be folded and/or locked while the taxi is underway.
